summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no edits made):**  I had a sub-agent trace the full path: `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → auth middleware → `handlers.ts` → `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `useAuth.tsx`/`App.tsx`. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I did **not** find an obvious client-side wiring bug:  - Every watchlist row requires a real `user_id` (no default/guest watchlist exists in the schema). - Every watchlist handler scopes reads/writes/deletes by `user_id` de
